hypotheses.E1_reconstructed_writes_are_equivalent: Every seed pair's hard-write disagreement is at most 20% of their mean native reconstruction error on every corpus.
hypotheses.E2_output_distributions_are_equivalent: Every seed pair's symmetric prediction KL is at most 10% of their mean KL to the native distribution on every corpus.
hypotheses.E3_selected_projectors_are_equivalent: Every seed pair's mean basis-invariant selected-projector overlap is at least 0.80 on every corpus.
hypotheses.E4_per_example_error_profiles_are_equiva: Every seed pair's per-example native-KL correlation is at least 0.80 on every corpus.
hypotheses.E5_approximation_top1_is_equivalent: Every seed pair's approximate-output top-1 agreement is at least 95% on every corpus.
